messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion for release/2026-05-12 paused: ci-staging artifact restore failed: cache restore checksum mismatch for wheel. Holding auto-promo. https://ci.internal/runs/14567

carla: ugh, which artifact?

deploy-bot: Artifact: redwood_core_ext-2.0.0-py3-none-any.whl expected=ab12ef34 actual=de34cd56

tom: paste tail of fetch logs pls

carla: logs snippet:
```
GET /cache/mirror/redwood_core_ext-2.0.0.whl 200
stream copy failed: checksum mismatch
expected=ab12ef34... actual=de34cd56...
storage backend returned truncated object
```

infra-ops: mirror-sync reported multipart finalize errors at 04:22 UTC for prefix redwood_core_ext/2.0.0. Could be uploader timeout.

sre-kim: two safe paths in a rolling change window: 1) reupload mirrors and retry promo (might miss change window) 2) pin release to last-known-good digest and proceed, then rebuild+reupload after. How much time left in window?

carla: 33 minutes. leaning to pin+promote to avoid delaying downstream releases.

tom: found last-good digest in metadata bucket: s3://prod-mirror/redwood_core_ext/2.0.0/sha256.txt -> ab12ef34

sre-kim: if we pin we should: create incident INC-2026-231, add rollback steps (how to unpin), and run a quick wheel sanity check against source-tree hash.

carla: running dry-run pin:
```bash
# dry-run
deploybot promote --release release/2026-05-12 --artifact redwood_core_ext==2.0.0 --digest ab12ef34 --force-pin --dry-run
```

carla: dry-run output: OK. No manifest mismatches. Proceeding with promote.

deploy-bot: Promote accepted: release pinned to digest ab12ef34. Auto-promo resumed. Promotion complete.

infra-ops: created INC-2026-231 and assigned to infra-blobstore. Will audit recent uploader runs and multipart finalize calls.

tom: updating release notes: "redwood_core_ext 2.0.0 pinned to known-good artifact digest due to cache restore checksum mismatch; follow-up rebuild and mirror reupload scheduled."

sre-kim: marking thread resolved for release. Incident stays open for RCA.
